topics.title: International context of India's foreign policy

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how the post-war world and India's own concerns shaped its early foreign policy.
Interpret Nehru's view that the conduct of foreign relations is the test of independence.
Identify the Directive Principles in Article 51 on promoting international peace and security.

topics.title: The policy of non-alignment and Nehru's role
topics.ncert_sections: The Policy of non-alignment; Nehru's role; Distance from two camps

concepts.learning_objective: State the objectives of Nehru's foreign policy and the domestic debate around it.
Analyse why India kept away from Cold War military blocs and how it balanced between them.
Explain India's efforts for Asian unity, decolonisation and against racism.
Describe the significance of the Bandung Conference and the founding of the Non-Aligned Movement.

topics.title: Peace with China: Panchsheel and Tibet
topics.ncert_sections: Peace and conflict with China; Tibet

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the friendly start of India-China relations and the Panchsheel principles of 1954.
Explain how the Tibet question caused tension between India and China.
Describe the India-China boundary dispute and the course of the 1962 war.
Evaluate the effects of the 1962 war on India's image, leadership and external ties.
Explain the war's effect on the Communist Party of India and on the Northeast.
Explain the Kashmir conflict of 1947 and the cooperation that continued, including the Indus Waters Treaty.
Describe the course and outcome of the 1965 war and the Tashkent Agreement.

topics.title: Bangladesh war, 1971 and the cost of conflict

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the crisis in East Pakistan and the course and outcome of the 1971 war.
Analyse the US-China-Pakistan axis and the Indo-Soviet Treaty of 1971.
Explain how the wars with neighbours affected India's planning and defence spending.

topics.title: India's nuclear policy and shifting alliances
topics.ncert_sections: India's nuclear policy; Shifting alliances in world politics

concepts.learning_objective: Explain India's nuclear programme, its 1974 test and its stand on the NPT.
Describe the shifts in India's foreign policy after 1977 and after 1990.
Evaluate the broad consensus among Indian parties on foreign policy matters.
